start: Enquiries screen; gym web pages are open and the web page AI helper is on; one visitor chat needs the gym

steps.action: Open Enquiries
user_sees: The chats that need the gym come first in the list
On the row: 'Chat on your web page', a status line in the warning colour, and the whole chat with 'Visitor: ' and 'AI helper: ' in front of each line, newest last
must_not: A chat that needs the gym below ordinary rows
Lines of another visitor's chat in this row

steps.action: Read the chat, then call or WhatsApp the visitor
user_sees: 'Call' and 'WhatsApp' open with the visitor's number
must_not: The panel answering the visitor by itself

steps.action: Tap 'Mark as done'
user_sees: The 'Mark as done' button is gone
The status line ends with ' · Done' in the quiet colour
The row leaves the top of the list
must_not: The chat deleted
The enquiry itself closed or marked not interested

start: Enquiries screen; gym web pages are open; a visitor left a question with the form on the page

steps.action: Open Enquiries and read the row
user_sees: 'Asked on your web page' and under it the question in quotation marks
The question is not shown a second time as the interest line
must_not: The question shown twice
Line breaks of the question lost

start: Enquiries screen; an enquiry that has a web chat and a web question; then the switches are turned off

steps.action: With the web page AI helper off, open Enquiries
user_sees: No 'Chat on your web page' block
No 'Mark as done' button
Rows in their ordinary order
must_not: The chat block left half drawn
A blank screen

steps.action: With gym web pages closed to visitors, open Enquiries
user_sees: No 'Asked on your web page' block on the row
must_not: An error in place of the row
The name and number of the visitor lost

steps.action: Look at a chat visitor who left no number
user_sees: 'No number left yet'; no 'Call' or 'WhatsApp'
must_not: A call button with no number

start: Enquiries screen; a chat marked done earlier

steps.action: The visitor writes again on the web page and needs the gym; refresh Enquiries
user_sees: The row is at the top again with the warning colour and the 'Mark as done' button
must_not: A chat that stays done after the visitor asks again

steps.action: Open an enquiry whose chat is older than 90 days
user_sees: 'Chat on your web page', the status line, then 'The chat's messages were deleted 90 days after the last one.'
must_not: Old messages still shown after 90 days
An empty box with no words

start: Enquiries screen; a visitor chatted on the gym's web page

steps.action: Sign in as this role and open Enquiries
user_sees: The whole chat of the visitor, readable by the owner and by front desk staff of this gym
must_not: The chat of another gym's visitor
The chat readable without signing in

steps.action: Look at the chat 90 days after its last message
user_sees: Only the line that the messages were deleted
must_not: Chat text kept past 90 days
